completion_rule: A use case may complete only with an exact scoped statement, a proof or certificate under explicitly stated established theorems, reproducible evidence and no unresolved dependency inside that scope. Independent review is not required to continue or publish internal results; not reviewed must remain explicit.
global_status_rule: No automatic promotion of Millennium claims, external certification or prize eligibility. Never claim review was performed if it was not.

active_cases.exit: Correct polynomial-time witness-producing solver for disjoint local gate blocks with arbitrary affine coupling on one output per block; check positive and negative instances.
Establish trivial 5-primary Sha for E_41 without assuming BSD or generalized Kato nonvanishing. A failed certificate is explicitly incomplete, not completion.
